verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a warehouse-native design: data is not copied into a separate system, and Events data is stored in the customer's own warehouse. This lets users keep data wherever their warehouse lives, and a community report corroborates that no data is stored in Hightouch out of the box. However, there is no documented Hightouch region selection or residency control, so the location choice depends on the customer's own warehouse. Missing for 10: an explicit Hightouch region/residency selection (e.g. EU/US workspace hosting), documentation of where Hightouch's own processing and metadata reside, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: It runs on top of your data warehouse, so teams can use customer data without copying it into a separate system.
Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.
Hightouch's hybrid architecture stores no data in Hightouch itself out of the box—it all stays in the customer's own warehouse/S3 bucket
